```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(gatekeepR)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

Review actions are append-only. Each action has an order, reviewer, reason,
image and target identity. Effective results are calculated by replaying the
active actions; undo restores the prior effective decision without deleting rows.

```{r review}
config <- gk_example_config()
prep <- gk_prepare(gk_simulate(n_cells = 300L, seed = 7L), config, quiet = TRUE)
thresholds <- gk_thresholds(prep, config, seed = 7L)
classification <- gk_classify(prep, thresholds, config)
states <- gk_state_calls(prep, thresholds, classification, config)
structures <- gk_structures(classification, prep)
review <- gk_review(classification, states, structures, thresholds, prep)
image_id <- prep$cells$image_id[[1L]]
review <- gk_set_cut(review, image_id, marker = "PanCK", estimate = 3,
  reviewer = "example-reviewer", reason = "Demonstrate a manual boundary")
review <- gk_dispose(review, image_id, cell_id = prep$cells$cell_id[[1L]],
  disposition = "DELETE", reviewer = "example-reviewer", reason = "Demonstrate exclusion")
reviewed <- gk_replay(review)
stopifnot(!reviewed$cells$analysed[[1L]])
```

`gk_save_review()` writes a staged, checksummed checkpoint and
`gk_load_review()` validates and restores it. A loaded review retains its
checkpoint revision; a stale concurrent save fails until the review is reloaded.
Owner locks persist across R processes. Once the previous owner has stopped,
`gk_load_review(path, takeover = TRUE)` explicitly claims that checkpoint in the
new process; never take over an active reviewer.
`gk_lock()` returns a separate snapshot. Keep that return value and pass it to
`gk_export()`; the editable review remains a separate object.

```{r export}
checkpoint_dir <- tempfile("gatekeepR-checkpoint-")
gk_save_review(review, checkpoint_dir)
loaded <- gk_load_review(checkpoint_dir)
snapshot <- gk_lock(loaded, reviewer = "example-reviewer", status = "PENDING")
export_dir <- tempfile("gatekeepR-export-")
gk_export(snapshot, export_dir)
checks <- gk_verify_export(export_dir, expected_review_id = snapshot$review_id_full)
stopifnot(all(checks$ok))
```

Version 2 binds typed source/replay inputs, correction model, ledgers, effective
scores/cells/states and reviewer/status to the content ID. It verifies file
transport and exact numerical replay before publication. REVIEWED records an
explicit human assertion, not authenticated identity or biological validity.
Retain the full ID independently when checking delivered exports: a completely
replaced export cannot be authenticated by hashes stored only inside itself.

Preserve version 1 checkpoints and exports unchanged. Regenerate analytical
objects from original source/configuration, re-review changed results and save
to new paths. Legacy export inspection is available explicitly via
`gk_read_export(path, verify = FALSE)` and does not claim integrity. The new
scientific and hash bindings deliberately reject old mixed analytical objects.
